sources.notes: HARD BLOCKED for OrcSDR use. The FMLIST/FMSCAN terms (operator-reviewed 2026-09-10) explicitly enumerate 'derivative work(s)', 'public software', and 'commercial product(s) or service(s)' as requiring prior written authorisation from Radio Data Center GmbH — every one of those describes an OrcSDR device pack. The thin-client argument that rescued nz_rsm_rrf does NOT apply here because FMLIST names derivative works and public software specifically. FMLIST's own disclaimer also acknowledges the data itself comes from other sources including 'government and authorities databases' — those upstream sources are where OrcSDR should go directly. Do not stage FMLIST or FMSCAN data. Do not scrape. This ledger row exists to document the block and prevent re-attempts.
